
# Parallax

This document contains the publication in Latex format about the displacement of diffraction peaks position
in a diffraction pattern due to a volumetric absorption in the thickness of the sensor used in the detector.

## Section name

- [library](https://github.com/kif/parallax/tree/main/library): The library with all articles cited in this document.
- [latex](https://github.com/kif/parallax/tree/main/main.tex): The latex source code of this document.
